analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (109,520 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (97,918/110,637/124,347 KRW) — Trading near the middle band, below short-term EMAs, above mid-term EMAs.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (109,070/86,709 KRW) — Above long-term EMAs, indicating sustained long-term trend strength.
· 52-week Position (64.7%) + Current price level historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (39.9 → 48.1) — Exiting oversold into neutral, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1317.6579 → -1020.2656) — Improving in negative territory, bearish convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band 110,637 KRW) — Sideways near the middle band, 40.31% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (75,565 KRW) — Pivot S1 (83,050 KRW) acting as a short-term support.
· Swing Resistance (126,170 KRW) — Pivot R1 (135,440 KRW) acting as a short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low 82,500 KRW, 20-day low 82,500 KRW. 5-day high 110,015 KRW, 20-day high 134,890 KRW. No clear pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.43x) — Significant increase compared to 5-day average, adding conviction to price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive sessions, consolidating after a sharp 5-day rally, lacking clear directional bias.
